title: The default Space site theme and its font set read "Default", freeing "Frequency" for the platform design system

source.ref: ADR-1736. Owner 2026-10-13: change the name of the default Frequency theme to Default; the new theme will be match the Frequency theme styles.

detail:
lib/theme/site-style.ts and lib/theme/space-themes.ts label the `frequency` id Default; the website editor's theme picker (components/sites/editor/shell.tsx) labels its DAWN snapshot Default; the help article and NAMING.md follow. Ids are unchanged, so every saved siteStyle.theme and preferences.theme keeps resolving.

Shipped 2026-10-13.
